knobs.name: camera_kept_absent

L5-1: picture record of P1 is JFIF, SOI to EOI, 640 x 480

knobs.mechanism: argument `state` of sysTester.BENCH_LINE(CAMERA, ON) is rewritten to OFF: the camera stays unavailable for the capture that must succeed; the test's teardown binds the driver again by a bench action, so no later test is affected

knobs.name: capture_after_restart_dropped

L3-1: picture record of P1 is JFIF, SOI to EOI, 640 x 480

knobs.mechanism: the second productManager.CAPTURE of the test (the one after the restart, selected by occurrence) is rewritten to cmdDisp.CMD_NO_OP: no picture is acquired after the restart

knobs.name: capture_twice

L2-1: last(piCamera.LastPictureSize) == size of the picture record of the ground file of the last product written

knobs.mechanism: productManager.CAPTURE is sent twice in a row (inserted copy): two pictures are acquired where the test expects one; the window stays complete and P1 is still downlinked

knobs.name: corrupt_picture

L2-2: picture record of P2 is JFIF, SOI to EOI, 640 x 480
sha256 of the picture records of P1 and P2 differ

knobs.mechanism: sysTester.CORRUPT_PRODUCT(name) is inserted before the second productManager.DOWNLINK of the test (selected by occurrence): the first two bytes of the picture record of the stored product are overwritten on board; the test removes its products at teardown
